settings.question: Do you ship overseas?
settings.answer: Yes, we ship all over the world. Shipping costs will apply, and will be added at checkout. We run discounts and promotions all year, so stay tuned for exclusive deals.

settings.question: How long will it take to get my orders?
settings.answer: It depends on where you are. Orders processed here will take 5-7 business days to arrive. Overseas deliveries can take anywhere from 7-16 days. Delivery details will be provided in your confirmation email.

settings.question: Any question?
settings.answer: You can contact us through our contact page! We will be happy to assist you.

settings.question: Can I place an order from my country?
settings.answer: We accept orders in nine countries and regions: Australia, Hong Kong, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan, Thailand, Vietnam, and New Zealand (as of July 24, 2026).

settings.question: Are there any limits on the quantity I can buy?
settings.answer: Some products have quantity limits. If you get an error when entering the quantity, it may be because you've exceeded the limit.

settings.question: I'm not sure if my order was successfully placed. Can I check the order status?
settings.answer:
After your order is successfully placed, you will receive an "Order confirmation email." If you don't receive it, please check your domain and spam folder settings.
If you're a registered member, you can view your order details from "Order History."

settings.question: Can I buy a product after the availability period has ended?
settings.answer: You can't buy a product after the availability period. Our products are made to order.

settings.question: What should I do if the product is damaged or defective?
settings.answer: If you find the product damaged or defective after arrival, please contact our customer service team. If it's within 14 days from the shipping date, we will handle it through return or exchange. As a general rule, we don't replace product boxes.

settings.question: Can I cancel my order?
settings.answer: You can cancel your order before the product is shipped. Cancellations are not possible after the product has been shipped.

settings.question: Can I return a product?
settings.answer: Returns of products due to customer convenience are not permitted. (For orders placed in South Korea, changes are accepted within seven days of product arrival.)

settings.question: Can I change the product after placing an order?
settings.answer: You can change the product before it is shipped. Exchanges are not possible after the product has been shipped. (For orders placed in South Korea, changes are accepted within seven days of product arrival.)

settings.question: Returns or exchanges due to initial defects
settings.answer: For returns or exchanges due to initial defects, the return and reshipping fees are covered by us.

settings.question: What payment methods are available?
settings.answer: We accept credit cards, PayPal, Apple Pay, Klarna, Alipay, Alipay HK, OVO, GoPay, Dana, Kakao, GrabPay MY, MOLPay, GCash, and GrabPay SG. Available payment options may vary depending on your country of purchase.

settings.question: Is the US dollar the only currency accepted?
settings.answer: This site allows payment in the local currency of each country where sales take place.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Delivery is typically scheduled within 10 days from the shipping date. However, delays may occur due to customs clearance or weather conditions. If your order has not arrived after 10 days, please contact us.

settings.question: Checking the delivery status
settings.answer: You can track your shipment via the FedEx website: https://www.fedex.com/en-us/tracking.html. Please enter the tracking number provided in your shipping confirmation email to check the status.

settings.question: Can I specify a delivery date and time?
settings.answer: We don't offer the option to specify a delivery date and time.

settings.question: Can I ship to an address different from the registered one?
settings.answer: After clicking "CHECK OUT," you can select a shipping address. To add a shipping address, click "Register a New Address."

settings.question: Can multiple orders be shipped at once?
settings.answer: Each order is shipped individually, so we are unable to combine multiple orders into a single shipment.

settings.question: Can you resend the product again after it was returned?
settings.answer: We can resend the product, but additional fees may apply depending on the reason.

settings.question: What should I do if I'm asked to pay additional fees at the time of delivery even though I've already paid customs duties and taxes?
settings.answer: If the delivery person requests additional payment, please inform them that you have already paid and contact our customer service team.

settings.question: What happens if I place an order from a country or region you can't ship to?
settings.answer: If you place an order from a country or region we can't ship to, we will contact you and cancel the order.

settings.question: How can I contact you?
settings.answer: You can reach us from our contact form.

settings.question: Business Hours of the Customer Service Team
settings.answer: The customer service team is open on weekdays, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM (Malaysia Time).
